title: lachemilla subalpestris
intro: Lachemilla subalpestris, commonly known as rockrose or creeping rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in treating wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Lachemilla subalpestris include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful for skin conditions and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Lachemilla subalpestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
